blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Underwater object detection is often limited by scarce and imbalanced training data and by strong appearance variations caused by turbidity, lighting, and differences between sensors. Existing data augmentation strategies, such as geometric or color augmentation or fully synthetic image generation with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), either lack semantic realism, fail to respect scene physics, or require additional annotations. In low-data domains like underwater environmental monitoring, the need for additional annotations is often the core bottleneck. Collecting new footage is hard, but labeling this dataset is even more time-consuming and costly, which limits how quickly a usable dataset can be constructed. We propose a unified fully automated zero-annotation pipeline that inserts class-conditioned trash objects into real underwater frames while preserving the original background context. Starting from sampled bounding boxes, each box is converted into an insertion mask and the object is pasted or generated within it, while the same box coordinates are automatically written as the corresponding annotation. Because labels are derived directly from the sampled boxes, the pipeline generates fully labeled training data for low-data settings without any manual annotation. Within this single pipeline we compare three strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation. We evaluate bounding-box faithfulness, visual realism, and the impact of the generated samples on downstream detector performance on the SeaClear underwater debris dataset. Results show that DALL-E improves detection performance in four of five domains, with relative gains of up to 96 percent over the real-only baseline.
blocks.zh: 水下物体的探测往往因训练数据稀少和不平衡而受到限制,并由于扰动、照明和传感器之间的差异而造成强烈的外观变化而受到限制。 现有的数据增强策略,如几何或色彩增强,或用Generative Adversarial Networks(GANs)完全合成图像生成,要么缺乏语义现实主义,不尊重场景物理学,要么需要附加说明. 在水下环境监测等低数据领域,需要附加说明往往是核心瓶颈. 收集新的镜头很困难,但给这个数据集贴上标签更加费时和昂贵,这限制了一个可用数据集的构建速度. 我们提出一个统一的全自动的零注解管道,在保留原始背景的同时,将有类条件的垃圾物品插入真正的水下框架. 从被取样的边框起,每个框被转换为插入口罩并被粘贴或在其内部生成,而同个框坐标则被自动写入相应的注释. 由于标签直接取自被采样的盒,管道生成全标签的低数据设置培训数据,而没有任何人工注释. 在这个单一的管道中,我们比较了三种策略:复制-再版、稳定分泌再版和DALL-E成像型。 我们评价了边框的忠诚度,视觉现实性,以及生成的样品对下游探测器在"海清"水下碎片数据集性能的影响. 结果显示,DALL-E在5个领域中的4个领域提高了检测性能,相对比实际基准提高96%。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The accumulation of underwater litter poses a critical threat to marine ecosystems, impacting biodiversity and water quality [ 1 ] . Efficient detection and removal of this debris are essential for environmental preservation. However, the underwater environment presents unique challenges for autonomous systems [ 2 ] . Reliable detection typically requires robust computer vision models, yet the development of these models is currently hindered by a significant lack of high-quality, diverse datasets [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 水下垃圾的积累对海洋生态系统构成严重威胁,影响到生物多样性和水质[1]。 有效探测和清除这些碎片对环境保护至关重要。 然而,水下环境对自主系统提出了独特的挑战[2]. 可靠的探测通常需要强有力的计算机视觉模型,但目前由于严重缺乏高质量、多样化的数据集,这些模型的开发受到阻碍[3]。

blocks.en: A key challenge is the limited availability of labeled underwater data. Unlike terrestrial datasets, underwater imagery is difficult to capture due to light attenuation, turbidity, and the sheer vastness of the ocean floor [ 4 , 5 ] . Consequently, there is a severe shortage of annotated images necessary to train deep learning models effectively for underwater object detection, leading to poor generalization in real-world scenarios [ 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 一项关键挑战是标签水下数据的提供有限。 与地面数据集不同的是,由于光衰减、扰动和洋底面积巨大[4、5],水下图像难以捕捉。 因此,严重缺乏为有效培训深层学习模型以进行水下物体探测而必需的附加说明的图像,导致现实世界情景的概括性差[6,7]。

blocks.en: Simply collecting more raw data does not resolve this bottleneck. Gathering extensive imagery for every unique location is both expensive and time-consuming, making it impractical for large-scale deployment. More critically, even when footage is available, it remains unusable for training until it is annotated: manually identifying and drawing boundaries around degraded, often partially buried or occluded litter demands substantial expert effort. In low-data underwater domains, it is therefore annotation cost, rather than data collection, that fundamentally limits how quickly detection models can be trained and deployed. This is the bottleneck our work directly targets.
blocks.zh: 仅仅收集更多的原始数据并不能解决这一瓶颈。 收集每个独特地点的大量图像既昂贵又费时,因此大规模部署是不切实际的。 更为关键的是,即使有录像,在附加说明之前,它仍然无法用于培训:需要专家作出大量努力,人工确定和划定退化的、往往被部分掩埋或掩埋的垃圾的界限。 因此,在低数据水下领域,从根本上限制检测模型培训和部署速度的是注释成本,而不是数据收集成本。 这是我们直接针对目标的工作瓶颈。

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose a unified fully automated zero-annotation pipeline for generating labeled underwater training data. The pipeline places trash objects at sampled locations within real underwater backgrounds. Each sampled bounding box serves a dual purpose: it acts as the spatial constraint that determines where the object is inserted, and its coordinates are written directly as the corresponding annotation. Because the label is derived from the box itself, no manual labeling is required at any stage of the process. Within this single pipeline, we instantiate and systematically compare three object-insertion strategies: copy-paste of real object crops, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation. While copy-paste provides guaranteed visual fidelity but limited diversity, SD inpainting offers controlled local editing and DALL-E represents unconstrained scene-aware generation. Therefore this choice enables fair comparison of the effect of synthetic object realism on detection pipeline, with fully automated annotation for all three methods.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立一个统一的全自动零通知管道,以生成贴有标签的水下训练数据。 输油管将垃圾放在在水下实际背景中取样的地点。 每个取样的边框都具有双重目的:它起到空间约束的作用,决定物体的插入地点,其坐标直接写成相应的注释. 由于标签来源于盒子本身,因此在过程的任何阶段都不需要手工标签. 在这个单一的管道中,我们即时并系统地比较三种物体插入策略:真实物体作物的复制版、稳定扩散涂料和DALL-E图像条件生成。 虽然复制版提供了可保证的视觉忠贞但多样性有限,但SD印版提供可控本地编辑,DALL-E代表不受约束的场景感知生成. 因此,这种选择能够对合成物体现实主义对探测管道的影响进行公平比较,对所有三种方法进行完全自动化的注释。

blocks.en: The motivation for this work lies in overcoming domain shifts and low-data regimes. Standard augmentation techniques such as rotation or color jittering provide only marginal gains, as they do not introduce new object variations [ 8 ] . Fully synthetic generation with GANs often struggles with structural consistency in complex underwater scenes [ 9 ] , and still requires the synthetic data to be annotated. Object-insertion approaches avoid the annotation problem by construction, but they differ widely in how realistically the inserted objects blend with the underwater scene. Rather than assuming any one generator is best, we treat realism as an empirical question and measure which insertion strategy actually translates into improved detection under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的动机在于克服域转移和低数据制度. 标准增强技术,如旋转或彩色振荡,只提供边际增益,因为它们没有引入新的对象变异[8]. 带有GANs的全合成生成经常在复杂的水下场景中与结构一致性发生斗争[9],仍然需要对合成数据进行注释. 对象插入方法通过构造避免了注释问题,但在插入的物体如何现实地与水下场景混合上,它们差别很大. 我们不认为任何一个生成者都是最佳的,而是把现实主义当作一个经验问题,并衡量插入策略实际上转化为域转移下更好的检测。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows: • We propose a fully automated, zero-annotation pipeline in which sampled bounding boxes act simultaneously as spatial generation constraints and as ready-to-use annotations, eliminating manual labeling entirely. • We perform a systematic comparison of three object-insertion strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation, within a single unified pipeline, evaluated across five domains of the SeaClear underwater debris dataset [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们建议建立一个完全自动化的零注解管道,其中取样的捆绑箱同时起到空间生成限制和即时使用说明的作用,完全取消人工标签。 我们系统比较了三种物体插入战略:复制-粘贴、稳定扩散喷涂和DALL-E成像条件生成,在一个单一的统一管道内,对海清水下碎片数据集五个领域进行评价[10]。

blocks.en: We propose a fully automated, zero-annotation pipeline in which sampled bounding boxes act simultaneously as spatial generation constraints and as ready-to-use annotations, eliminating manual labeling entirely.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个完全自动化的零注解管道,在这条管道中,取样的捆绑箱同时起到空间生成限制和即时使用说明的作用,完全取消人工标签。

blocks.en: We perform a systematic comparison of three object-insertion strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation, within a single unified pipeline, evaluated across five domains of the SeaClear underwater debris dataset [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们系统比较了三种物体插入战略:复制-粘贴、稳定扩散喷涂和DALL-E成像条件生成,在一个单一的统一管道内,对海清水下碎片数据集五个领域进行评价[10]。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows: Section II presents the related work and Section III describes the dataset used. Section IV details the synthetic data generation pipeline. Section V outlines our experimental setup and the evaluation criteria used. Section VI presents the results and a discussion of the observed performance gains. Finally, Section VII concludes the paper and suggests avenues for future research.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分如下:第二节介绍有关工作,第三节介绍所使用的数据集。 第四节详细介绍了合成数据生成管道。 第五节概述了我们的试验设置和所采用的评价标准。 第六节介绍成果,并讨论观察到的业绩收益。 最后,第七节总结了文件,并提出了今后研究的途径。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early underwater litter detection relied on manual diver surveys and towed-camera
review, which are primarily practical in shallow or accessible environments. The shift to deep learning improved both coverage and throughput: Valdenegro-Toro trained deep networks on forward-looking sonar images to detect submerged debris [ 11 ] , and Politikos et al. used a Mask R-CNN detector on towed-camera imagery to reach 62% mAP across eleven litter categories [ 12 ] . These results demonstrate the suitability of deep detectors as the standard tool for underwater litter monitoring, but all of them are trained on manually annotated data, which is exactly the bottleneck this study targets.
blocks.zh:
早期水下垃圾检测依靠人工潜水员调查和牵引摄像头
(c) 审查,主要是在浅薄或无障碍的环境中进行。 向深层学习的转变提高了覆盖面和吞吐量:Valdenegro-Toro对深层网络进行了前瞻性声纳图像培训,以探测淹没的碎片[11],Politicos等人在牵引摄像头图像上使用了Mask R-CNN探测器,在11个垃圾类别中达到62%的mAP[12]。 这些结果表明,深层探测器作为监测水下垃圾的标准工具是合适的,但所有探测器都接受了人工附加说明的数据培训,这正是本研究目标面临的瓶颈。

blocks.en: To reduce annotation cost, object-insertion augmentation pastes or renders objects into existing background images and derives labels directly from the placement coordinates. Dwibedi et al. showed that even naive "cut-and-paste" of object crops onto random backgrounds gives useful training signal for instance detectors [ 13 ] , and Ghiasi et al. later showed that large-scale jittering plus random copy-paste is a strong, simple augmentation for instance segmentation on natural images [ 14 ] . These methods are designed for terrestrial, clutter-controlled datasets (e.g., COCO) and have not been adapted to the low-visibility, low-data underwater debris setting, where background turbidity and small object scale change the trade-offs substantially.
blocks.zh: 为了降低注释成本,对象插入增强粘贴或使对象成为现有的背景图像,直接从放置坐标中获取标签. Dwibedi等人著. 例如探测器[13]和Ghiasi等人。 后显示,大规模振动加随机复制纸是一种强而简单的增强,例如在自然图像上分化[14]. 这些方法是为地面、杂乱控制数据集(例如COCO)设计的,没有适应低可见度、低数据水下碎片的设定,在这种环境下,背景模糊度和小物体尺度大大改变了权衡。

blocks.en:
Generative augmentation offers an alternative to copy-paste by synthesizing the inserted object rather than reusing a fixed crop. Latent diffusion models such as
Stable Diffusion support prompt- or mask-conditioned inpainting and can be fine-tuned on domain-specific images [ 15 ] , while proprietary image-conditioned models such as DALL-E can regenerate scene regions without any fine-tuning [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
基因增强通过合成插入对象,而不是重用固定的作物,为复制复制提供了一种替代品。 初级传播模型,例如:
Stable Difusion支持即时或口罩条件的涂装,可以在域特定图像上进行微调[15],而DALL-E等专有的图像条件模型可以在不进行微调的情况下重新生成场景区域[16].

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, no prior study has directly compared copy-paste augmentation, diffusion inpainting, and image-conditioned generation within a single automated annotation pipeline for underwater debris detection. Previous work has also not established whether distribution-level realism metrics, such as FID and KID, predict downstream detection improvements in this setting. We address this gap by deriving labels directly from the same sampled bounding boxes used for object insertion. This keeps the annotation procedure consistent across all three strategies and helps isolate the effect of object-generation quality on real-world detection performance under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有一项先前的研究直接比较了在用于水下碎片探测的单一自动注释管内复制复制件的放大、扩散涂层和图像条件生成。 以前的工作也没有确定FID和KID等分布级现实度量度是否预测这种环境下的下游检测改进. 我们通过直接从用于物体插入的同一取样边框中提取标签来解决这一缺口。 这保持了所有三种策略的注释程序的一致性,有助于在域移下隔离物体生成质量对现实世界检测性能的影响.

blocks.en: III Data
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 数据

blocks.en: III-A SeaClear Marine Debris Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A 海清海洋碎片数据集

blocks.en: We use the SeaClear Marine Debris Dataset, an underwater dataset annotated for object detection and instance segmentation. The dataset consists of 8610 images captured using various Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs) and multiple camera sensors across five geographic locations in Croatia and France, resulting in 11 domains total when accounting for camera and temporal variations [ 10 ] . Data were collected across five sites reflecting different human activities and underwater conditions: Jakljan, Croatia; Lokrum (Portoč), Croatia; Bistrina (Mali Ston Bay), Croatia; Slano, Croatia; and Marseille (L’Estaque), France.
blocks.zh: 我们使用海清海洋碎片数据集 一个水下数据集 附加说明的物体探测和实例分割。 数据集包括使用各种遥控飞行器捕获的8610幅图像以及克罗地亚和法国五个地理位置的多台相机传感器,因此,在计算相机和时间变化时,总共产生了11个领域[10]。 收集了反映人类不同活动和水下条件的五个地点的数据:克罗地亚雅克连;克罗地亚洛克鲁姆(波尔图奇);克罗地亚比斯特里纳(马里斯通湾);克罗地亚斯拉诺;法国马赛(L ' Estaque)。

blocks.en: III-B Targeted Low-Data Domains
blocks.zh: 目标低数据域

blocks.en: To evaluate the synthetic pipeline across diverse underwater regimes and data scarcity levels, we select five representative domains spanning very-low-data to low-data regimes. These five domains are characterized by significant domain shifts in turbidity, debris types, object scales, and environmental conditions: • Jakljan II (J2): 65 images, very-low-data regime with small objects. A Croatian islet location with lower debris density, dominated by bottles and cans linked to nautical tourism. • Slano II (S2): 71 images, very-low-data regime with small objects. A Croatian harbour village characterized by diverse debris often partially buried in construction rubble, making objects difficult to separate from background. • Lokrum II (L2): 77 images, very-low-data regime with small objects. A relatively clear Croatian site with Posidonia oceanica seagrass where litter mainly stems from tourism and nautical activity. • Slano I (S1): 168 images, low-data regime with medium-sized objects. The same harbour village as S2 but representing a different section with more medium-sized debris. • Bistrina III (B3): 193 images, low-data regime with larger objects and high turbidity. A Croatian site strongly influenced by oyster farming with sediment-rich, highly turbid water and common debris such as plastic trays and nets.
blocks.zh: 为了评估不同水下系统和数据稀缺程度的合成管道,我们选择了五个具有代表性的领域,涵盖非常低的数据到低数据系统。 这五个域的特点是,在扰动性,碎片类型,物体尺度和环境条件方面有显著的域位变化: • Jakljan II(J2):65幅图像,带有小物体的极低数据系统. 克罗地亚的岛屿位置,碎片密度较低,以瓶子和罐头为主,与航海旅游有关。 • Slano II(S2):71幅图像,带有小对象的极低数据系统. 克罗地亚一个港口村庄的特征是各种碎片,往往被部分埋在建筑瓦砾中,使物体难以与背景分开。 • Lokrum II(L2):77幅图像,极低数据制度,带有小对象. 克罗地亚的一个相对明显的地点是波西多尼亚海洋海草,那里的垃圾主要来自旅游业和航海活动。 • Slano I(S1):168幅图像,带有中型物体的低数据系统。 与S2相同的港口村庄,但代表着另一部分,碎片体积较大。 • Bistrina III(B3):193幅图像,低数据系统,具有较大的物体和高浊度。 克罗地亚的一个遗址受到牡蛎养殖业的强烈影响,其中沉积物丰富,水质松散,塑料托盘和蚊帐等常见废弃物。

blocks.en: III-C Annotations
blocks.zh: 三-C 说明

blocks.en: SeaClear annotations include four semantic classes: Trash (human-made debris: plastic, metal, rubber, glass, fibre), Plant (marine vegetation), Animal (marine fauna), and ROV (underwater robot parts visible in-frame). Since the goal of this work is autonomous litter removal, we focus only on the Trash class. All training, generation, and evaluation steps use the Trash class, and the other classes are not used.
blocks.zh: 海洋 明确的说明包括四个语义类: 垃圾堆(人造碎片:塑料、金属、橡胶、玻璃、纤维)、植物(海洋植被)、动物(海洋动物)和ROV(水下机器人部件在机框内可见)。 由于这项工作的目标是自主清除垃圾,我们只关注垃圾分类。 所有训练,生成,评价步骤都使用"垃圾课",其他课程则不使用.

blocks.en: IV Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 四 合成数据生成管道

blocks.en: This section details the fully automated zero-annotation synthetic data generation pipeline that compares three object-insertion strategies to address the scarcity of annotated underwater imagery.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了完全自动化的零注释合成数据生成管道,该管道比较了三种对象插入策略,以解决附加注释的水下图像的稀缺性.

blocks.en: IV-A Automated Bounding Box Generation and Constraints
blocks.zh: 四-A 自动框生成和制约

blocks.en: To ensure the generated objects are both realistic and useful for training, we implement a stochastic bounding box generation strategy. To ensure that boxes are large enough for reliable insertion or inpainting and meaningful object placement, we enforce minimum size constraints. When multiple boxes are generated in the same image, we also control overlap between boxes using an IoU threshold. If the overlap between any pair of boxes exceeds the threshold, the box is rejected and regenerated randomly. Boxes that fail the size or overlap constraints are resampled until a valid box is found. If a valid configuration is not found within a fixed number of iterations, the image is skipped to maintain high data quality.
blocks.zh: 为了确保生成的物体既现实又有益于培训,我们实施一种有条理的边框生成战略。 为了确保盒子足够大,可以可靠地插入或涂抹和有意义的物体放置,我们实施最小尺寸限制。 当多个盒在同一图像中生成时,我们也使用IoU阈值控制盒之间的重叠. 如果任意一对盒之间的重叠超过阈值,则该盒会被拒绝并随机重生成. 失败大小或重叠限制的框会被重印,直到找到有效的框。 如果在固定的重复数中找不到有效的配置,则会跳过图像以保持高数据质量.

blocks.en: IV-B Trash-type Selection and Prompt Mapping
blocks.zh: IV-B 回收站类型的选择和快速绘图

blocks.en: We define nine trash categories based on the most commonly occurring debris types in the SeaClear dataset composition: rubber tire, glass bottle, fiber rope, concrete pipe, plastic bottle, metal can, plastic bag, plastic pipe, and metal wreckage. Each category is mapped to a class-specific text prompt to condition the generative model. For each sampled box, a trash type is selected, and the corresponding prompt token is used to condition the Stable Diffusion and DALL-E models. The copy-paste strategy does not use prompts or trash-type conditioning; it samples a real object crop at random from a pooled crop library of real trash objects extracted from SeaClear and pastes it into the sampled box.
blocks.zh: 我们根据 " SeaClear " 数据集构成中最常见的碎片类型界定了9个垃圾类别:橡胶轮胎、玻璃瓶、纤维绳、水泥管、塑料瓶、金属罐、塑料袋、塑料管和金属残骸。 每个类别被映射成一个特定类别的文本,以附加基因模型。 对于每个样本框,会选择一个垃圾类型,并使用相应的即时符号来对稳定扩散和DALL-E模型进行条件化. 抄盘策略不使用提示或垃圾类型调制;它从一个集合的作物库中随机抽取出从SeaClear中提取出来的真正的垃圾对象,并将其粘贴到被抽取的盒子中.

blocks.en: IV-C Diffusion-Based Inpainting Pipeline
blocks.zh: IV-C 基于扩散的喷涂管道

blocks.en: We instantiate three object-insertion strategies within the same pipeline. Each strategy is run separately on the same source image. They sample the bounding boxes independently and produce automatic labels derived directly from their sampled boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一条管道内 立即执行三个目标插入策略 每个策略都在同一源图像上单独运行. 它们独立地对捆绑箱进行取样,并直接从其取样箱中产生自动标签。

blocks.en:
• Copy-Paste:
Real trash crops are extracted from annotated SeaClear images to form a crop library. For each sampled box, a crop of the selected trash type is resized to the box and pasted onto the real background. This provides high object realism but limited diversity. • Stable Diffusion (SD) Inpainting:
For each sampled and validated box, a binary mask is generated and passed, together with the background image and a class-specific prompt, to a Stable Diffusion inpainting model [ 15 ] . The model performs latent-space inpainting, blending the generated object into the local lighting, texture, and turbidity. To better match the underwater domain, we additionally fine-tune the inpainting model on 12968 real trash crops extracted from SeaClear, using domain-specific fine-tuning (5 epochs, learning rate 5 x 10 − 6 10^{-6} , cosine schedule, 8-bit Adam). During inference, inpainting is performed with strength=0.8 (mask influence), guidance scale=7.5 (classifier-free guidance strength), and num inference steps=50 (diffusion steps). • DALL-E image-conditioned generation:
A real underwater image and a class-specific prompt are submitted to DALL-E’s image generation API [ 16 ] . DALL-E regenerates portions of the scene contextually to integrate the trash, producing a complete synthetic image. This strategy produces realistic underwater objects without any model fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
• 复制件:
从注解的 SeaClear 图像中提取真正的垃圾作物,形成作物库. 对于每个样本框,所选垃圾类型的一个裁剪被调整到框中,粘贴到真实的背景上. 这提供了较高的对象现实主义,但多样性有限. • 稳定扩散(SD)涂料:
对于每个被采样和验证的盒子,会生成一个二进制的面具,连同背景图像和一个特定等级的提示,一起传递到一个稳定扩散喷漆模型[15]. 该模型进行潜在空间油漆,将生成的物体混合到局部的照明、纹理和模糊度。 为了更好地匹配水下领域,我们额外微调了从SeaClear中提取的12968种真垃圾作物的涂装模型,采用了特定域的微调(5个epocs,学习率5×10 − 6 10^{-6},余弦表,8位亚当). 在推导过程中,以强度=0.8(任务影响),制导尺度=7.5(无级机的制导强度),纳姆推导步骤=50(散射步骤)进行涂装. • DALL-E 图像条件下的生成:
一个真实的水下图像和一个特定等级的提示被提交到DALL-E的图像生成API [16]. DALL-E根据背景重新生成部分场景,以整合垃圾,产生完整的合成图像. 这种策略产生现实的水下物体,而没有任何模型微调.

Copy-Paste:
Real trash crops are extracted from annotated SeaClear images to form a crop library. For each sampled box, a crop of the selected trash type is resized to the box and pasted onto the real background. This provides high object realism but limited diversity.

从注解的 SeaClear 图像中提取真正的垃圾作物,形成作物库. 对于每个样本框,所选垃圾类型的一个裁剪被调整到框中,粘贴到真实的背景上. 这提供了较高的对象现实主义,但多样性有限.

The model performs latent-space inpainting, blending the generated object into the local lighting, texture, and turbidity. To better match the underwater domain, we additionally fine-tune the inpainting model on 12968 real trash crops extracted from SeaClear, using domain-specific fine-tuning (5 epochs, learning rate 5 x 10 − 6 10^{-6} , cosine schedule, 8-bit Adam). During inference, inpainting is performed with strength=0.8 (mask influence), guidance scale=7.5 (classifier-free guidance strength), and num inference steps=50 (diffusion steps).

DALL-E image-conditioned generation:
A real underwater image and a class-specific prompt are submitted to DALL-E’s image generation API [ 16 ] . DALL-E regenerates portions of the scene contextually to integrate the trash, producing a complete synthetic image. This strategy produces realistic underwater objects without any model fine-tuning.

DALL- E 图像条件生成 :
一个真实的水下图像和一个特定等级的提示被提交到DALL-E的图像生成API [16]. DALL-E根据背景重新生成部分场景,以整合垃圾,产生完整的合成图像. 这种策略产生现实的水下物体,而没有任何模型微调.

blocks.en: IV-D Output Generation and Annotation
blocks.zh: 四-D 产出生成和注释

blocks.en: The pipeline produces two outputs per processed image, regardless of insertion strategy: the synthetic image containing the newly inserted trash, and a corresponding annotation file. The annotation coordinates come directly from the sampled boxes, so no manual labeling is required. All inserted objects are mapped to a single Trash class, consistent with the litter-removal objective.
blocks.zh: 管道每个处理的图像产生两个输出,不管插入策略如何:包含新插入的垃圾的合成图像,以及相应的注释文件. 注释坐标直接来自样本框,因此不需要手动标注. 所有插入的物体均被映射为单一的垃圾分类,与垃圾清除目标一致。

blocks.en: IV-E Quality Gating and Validation
blocks.zh: IV-E 质量鉴定和鉴定

blocks.en: To ensure dataset integrity, generated samples are passed through an automated confidence-based quality filter. Each synthetic image is scored by the real-data baseline detector, and images in which the inserted object is not confidently detected (confidence below 0.5) are discarded, since these typically correspond to failed or unrealistic generations. This replaces subjective manual inspection with a reproducible, quantitative criterion. The filter removed between 11% and 25% of generated images depending on the domain, with higher removal rates in the harder, more turbid domains.
blocks.zh: 为了确保数据集的完整性,生成的样本通过一个基于信任的自动化质量过滤器传递. 每个合成图像都由真数据基线探测器打分,插入对象没有自信检测的图像(信心低于0.5)被丢弃,因为这些图像一般对应失败或不切实际的一代. 以可复制的定量标准取代主观人工检查. 过滤器根据域从生成的图像中移除了11%到25%,在更硬,更扭曲的域中清除率更高.

blocks.en: V Experiments and Evaluation Criteria
blocks.zh: 五. 试验和评价标准

blocks.en: This section describes how we evaluate the synthetic data generation pipeline comparing three object-insertion strategies in low-data underwater domains. The evaluation is designed to answer two key questions: 1. Do the generated samples look plausible and do they respect the intended box placement? 2. Do the generated samples improve real-world detection performance under domain shift?
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们如何评价合成数据生成管道,比较低数据水下领域的三项物体插入战略。 评价旨在回答两个关键问题: 1. 生成的样品看起来是否合理,它们是否尊重预定的盒子放置? 2. 生成的样品是否改善了域转移下真实世界的探测性能?

blocks.en: Do the generated samples look plausible and do they respect the intended box placement?
blocks.zh: 生成的样品看起来是否合理,它们是否尊重预定的盒子放置?

blocks.en: Do the generated samples improve real-world detection performance under domain shift?
blocks.zh: 生成的样本是否在域位移下改善了现实世界的检测性能?

blocks.en: V-A Experimental Design
blocks.zh: V-A 实验设计

blocks.en: We evaluate the pipeline on five SeaClear domains: J2, S2, L2 (very-low-data, small objects) and B3, S1 (low-data, larger objects). For each domain we compare seven training conditions: a real-only baseline, and the three insertion strategies (copy-paste, SD, DALL-E) each in two variants: synthetic-only, and synthetic combined with a 25% subset of real-world baseline images. The 25% real-data subset is used because mixing a small proportion of real data with synthetic data generalizes better than using the full real set, since a large real set can outweigh the smaller synthetic set and limit its contribution during training [ 17 ] . The test set for each domain consists exclusively of real, held-out images that are never used for training, validation, or synthetic generation, ensuring an unbiased estimate of real-world performance. Since box sampling and generation are stochastic, each generative configuration is run with three random seeds and results are averaged across them. All detectors use the latest You Only Look Once (YOLO) model - YOLO26n [ 18 , 19 ] (nano variant) trained for 100 epochs and all evaluation is performed on the Trash class only.
blocks.zh: 我们评价五个海清域上的管道:J2,S2,L2(非常低数据,小物体)和B3,S1(低数据,大物体). 对于每个领域,我们比较了七个训练条件:一个真实的基线,以及三个插入策略(复制-paste,SD,DALL-E),各分为两个变体:合成-只,合成与25%的分集现实世界基线图像结合. 使用了25%的真数据子集,因为将一小部分真数据与合成数据混合,比使用完整的真数据集更能概括,因为一个大的真数据集可以超过较小的合成数据集,并限制其在训练过程中的贡献[17]. 每个域的测试集完全由从未用于训练、验证或合成生成的真实的、被搁置的图像组成,确保对现实世界的性能进行公正的估计。 由于盒式采样和生成具有斯图克性,因此每个基因组的配置都有3个随机种子运行,结果平均横跨它们. 所有探测器都使用最新的You Only Look Once(YOLO)型号——YOLO26n [18,19](无变体)为100个纪元训练,所有评价都只在垃圾班上进行.

blocks.en: V-B Box Faithfulness
blocks.zh: V-B 信条

blocks.en: A critical requirement for synthetic trash generation is that the generative model accurately respects the spatial constraints of the provided bounding boxes. Since our boxes are stochastically sampled, we evaluate ‘box faithfulness’, which represents the degree to which the model produces a non-trivial insertion strictly inside the intended region, using a relative change score.
blocks.zh: 合成垃圾生成的一个关键要求是,基因模型应准确尊重所提供的边框的空间限制。 由于我们的盒子有条理地取样,我们评价“盒子的忠诚度”,这代表了模型在预定区域内使用相对变化分数产生非三角插入的程度。

blocks.en: The bounding box faithfulness F F is measured by comparing the generated image with its corresponding real image to estimate how much the model changed the scene. For each sampled bounding box, we compute the average pixel change inside the box and compare it to the average pixel change outside the boxes (i.e., in the background). If the change is clearly larger inside than outside, the edit is localized to the intended region and the box is considered faithful. This indicates the inpainting respects the spatial constraint and avoids unintended background drift.
blocks.zh: 通过将生成的图像与其相应的真实图像进行比较,以估计模型对场景的改变程度,来测量边框的忠诚度F F. 对于每个抽样的边框,我们计算出框内的平均像素变化,并将其与框外的平均像素变化(即背景)进行比较. 如果内部的变化明显大于外部,则编辑会本地化到预定区域,盒子被认为是忠实的. 这表明印画尊重空间限制,避免了无意的背景漂移.

blocks.en: More specifically, the bounding box faithfulness is defined as F = Δ in − Δ out Δ out , F=\frac{\Delta_{\text{in}}-\Delta_{\text{out}}}{\Delta_{\text{out}}}, (1) where Δ in \Delta_{\text{in}} denotes the average pixel change inside the target bounding box and Δ out \Delta_{\text{out}} denotes the average pixel change outside all bounding boxes (i.e., in the background).

blocks.en: A value F F > 0 indicates that pixel changes are concentrated in the target box rather than scattered into the background ( Δ in > Δ out \Delta_{\text{in}}>\Delta_{\text{out}} ). The quality threshold condition F > 0 F>0 can be used to filter out unreliable generations where the background changed more than the target region.
blocks.zh: 一个值 F F > 0 表示像素变化集中在目标框中,而不是分散到背景中(在 > > Delta > > text{in}中) Delta_{\text{out}}}. 质量阈值条件F > 0 F>0可以用来过滤背景变化大于目标区域的不可靠的世代.

blocks.en: Box faithfulness is reported for the generative strategies (SD and DALL-E); for copy-paste the inserted crop fills the box by construction, so the measure is not informative.
blocks.zh: 关于基因策略(SD和DALL-E)的框忠诚度报告;关于复制版,插入的作物通过构件填充框,因此该措施没有资料。

blocks.en: V-C Visual Realism
blocks.zh: V-C 视觉现实主义

blocks.en: To assess whether synthetic samples resemble real underwater imagery, we compute Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and Kernel Inception Distance (KID). Both metrics evaluate distributional similarity between real and synthetic images using feature embeddings extracted from a pretrained Inception network.
blocks.zh: 为了评估合成样品是否与真实的水下图像相似,我们计算了Fréchet受体距离(FID)和Kernel受体距离(KID)。 两种度量衡都利用从预先训练的Inception网络提取的特征嵌入来评价真实图像和合成图像之间的分布相似性.

blocks.en: FID fits multivariate Gaussian distributions to the Inception features of real and synthetic images and computes the Fréchet distance between their means and covariances [ 20 ] . Lower FID values indicate that the synthetic image distribution is closer to the real image distribution in feature space.
blocks.zh: FID符合真实和合成图像的受体特征的多变高斯分布,并计算其手段与共变之间的弗雷切特距离[20]. 较低的FID值表示合成图像分布更接近特征空间中的真实图像分布.

blocks.en: KID measures the discrepancy between real and synthetic feature distributions using the squared Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), typically with a polynomial kernel [ 21 ] . Like FID, lower KID values indicate greater similarity between real and synthetic images. Unlike FID, KID provides an unbiased estimator and is generally considered more reliable when the number of samples is limited [ 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: KID 使用平方平均最大差值(MMD)测量真实特征分布和合成特征分布之间的差异,通常具有多诺核[21]. 像FID一样,较低的KID值表明真实图像和合成图像的相似性更大. 与FID不同,KID提供了一个无偏见的估算器,在样本数量有限时一般被认为更为可靠[21,22].

blocks.en: V-D Detection Performance on Real Test Images
blocks.zh: V- D 真实测试图像的检测性能

blocks.en: Detection performance is evaluated only on a separate test split that is not used during training or validation containing real images, from each target domain to ensure a fair assessment. mAP (mean Average Precision) is computed for the Trash class, using mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95. mAP@0.5 uses an IoU threshold of 0.5 and is relatively lenient, while mAP@0.5:0.95 averages AP over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05, providing a stricter and more localization-sensitive measure.
blocks.zh: 检测性能只通过单独的测试分拆来评价,在培训或验证过程中没有使用,包含真实图像,从每个目标域来看,以确保公平评估. mAP(平均平均精度)是用mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95计算出来的。 mAP@0.5使用0.5的IoU阈值,相对宽松,而mAP@0.5:0.95的AP比IoU阈值平均值为0.5至0.95,为0.05的步骤,提供了更严格,更本地化的敏感措施.

blocks.en: VI Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: We first verify that both SD inpainting and DALL-E respect the spatial constraints imposed by sampled boxes. Table I reports the median faithfulness score F F (Eq. 1 ) for each strategy separately, across all five domains. In every domain and for both strategies, all generated images pass the faithfulness check ( F F > 0), meaning the pixel change inside each target box is consistently larger than the change in the surrounding background. Median F F ranges from 19.17 to 43.48 for SD inpainting and from 20.74 to 42.45 for DALL-E, with no consistent ordering between the two strategies across domains. SD is higher in three domains, DALL-E in two, and differences never exceed 3 points. Both generative strategies therefore localize their edits comparably well within the target box, despite DALL-E regenerating substantially larger portions of the surrounding scene, as reflected in its far higher whole-image FID and KID (Table II ). This shows that DALL-E’s broader scene-level drift does not come at the cost of box-level localization and the automatically generated labels remain spatially valid for both strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们首先核实SD涂层和DALL-E都尊重被取样的盒子带来的空间限制。 图表 我报告,在所有五个领域,每个战略的中位信得分F F (Eq. 1)。 在每一个领域和两种策略中,所有生成的图像都通过忠诚度检查(F F > 0),这意味着每个目标框内的像素变化始终大于周围背景的变化. FF中位数从19.17到43.48不等,而DALL-E中位数从20.74到42.45不等,这两个战略之间没有跨越各领域的一致顺序。 SD在3个域中较高,DALL-E在2个域中,差异从未超过3个点. 因此,尽管DALL-E在周围的场景中恢复了相当大一部分,但两种基因策略都使其编辑在目标框中的位置相当接近(见表二)。 这表明,DALL-E的更广泛的场景级漂移并不以箱级本地化为代价,自动生成的标签在空间上对两种策略依然有效.

两个来自不同水下条件的场景例子: 第1,L2(小物体,较清晰的水)排行B3(较大的物体,较高的浊度)第2. 每行显示:真实的图像,复制版的增强,SD的涂装,以及DALL-E的图像条件生成.

blocks.en: The realism ranking reveals a critical insight: distribution-level realism (FID and KID) does not predict downstream detection performance. The same decoupling appears at the localization level, despite its much higher whole-image FID/KID, DALL-E’s edits remain as tightly confined to the sampled box as SD’s (Table I ), indicating that global distributional drift and local edit precision are independent properties of a generator. SD inpainting achieves the lowest FID and KID across all domains, yet fails to improve detection (see Table III ). This occurs because FID and KID measure whole-image statistical similarity, which is dominated by background preservation. SD inpainting preserves the entire real underwater background untouched while inserting objects in a small box, resulting in synthetic images that are statistically very close to real at the whole-image level (low FID and KID), yet the inserted objects are unrealistically large and unrecognizable to the detector. Copy-paste, which also preserves the real background but with sharper discontinuities, scores intermediate. DALL-E image-conditioned generation regenerates portions of the scene, resulting in higher FID and KID values (especially in domains J2 and L2 where FID exceeds 200) because the whole-image statistics drift further from real. However, DALL-E produces object-level realism, i.e., the inserted trash appears plausible with realistic size, texture, and corrosion that is invisible to distribution-level metrics but directly drives detection gains.
blocks.zh: 现实主义的排名揭示了一个关键的洞察力:分布级现实主义(FID和KID)并不预测下游的探测性能. 本地化层面也出现了同样的脱钩现象,尽管DALL-E的全图像FID/KID要高得多,但其编辑仍然和SD一样紧紧地局限在被取样的盒子中(表一),这表明全球分布漂移和本地编辑精度是发电机的独立属性. 自毁油漆在所有领域达到最低的FID和KID,但未能改进检测(见表三)。 出现这种情况的原因是FID和KID测量全图像统计的相似性,以背景保存为主. SD涂装保留了整个真实的水下背景,同时将物体插入一个小盒子中,导致合成图像在统计学上非常接近全图像层(低FID和KID),然而插入的物体并不现实大,对探测器无法识别. 复制版(Copy-paste),它也保留了真实的背景,但具有更尖锐的不连续性,得分中间. DALL-E图像条件生成再生部分场景,导致FID值和KID值更高(特别是在FID超过200的J2和L2领域),因为全图像统计从真实中进一步漂移. 然而,DALL-E产生物体级现实主义,即插入的垃圾似乎具有现实的大小、纹理和腐蚀性,而这种腐蚀性对于分布级的计量标准来说是看不见的,但直接驱动检测结果。

blocks.en: The detector does not care about distribution-level statistics; it only cares whether it can recognize the trash object. DALL-E achieves detection gains despite higher FID and KID values. This anti-correlation between FID and KID and detection performance reveals that whole-image metrics are poor proxies for augmentation quality in object insertion settings. Only downstream task performance is a reliable measure of synthetic utility.
blocks.zh: 探测器不关心分布级统计;它只关心是否能够识别垃圾对象. DALL-E尽管FID和KID值较高,但仍能实现检测增益. 这种FID和KID之间的抗腐蚀关系和检测性能显示,整像度测量在物体插入设置中对于增强质量来说是差的代词. 只有下游任务性能是合成效用的可靠度量.

blocks.en: SD inpainting and copy-paste fail to improve detection over the baseline in every domain. Even when combined with 25% real baseline images, both strategies produce near-zero or negligible gains (mAP@0.5 < 0.02 in all cases). This failure is consistent and reproducible across seeds. Analysis of object size distributions (Table IV ) reveals that SD inpainting and copy-paste have a hard minimum generation size of 8.2–11.4% of image width, whereas real underwater trash can be as small as 1.3–5.8%. This prevents generation of the smallest debris objects common in these domains, forcing the detector to learn from a biased, size-skewed synthetic distribution. Additionally, copy-paste suffers from sharp visual discontinuities where crops are pasted, creating unrealistic boundary artifacts. More fundamentally, SD-generated trash items lack realistic underwater appearance, the texture, corrosion patterns, and marine growth that characterize real debris. The failure of copy-paste confirms that constraints on generation, combined with lack of visual realism, are barriers to success. DALL-E, by contrast, can generate objects across the full real size range (minimum 3.5–7.7%) and with realistic underwater appearance (Table IV ), enabling successful detection transfer.
blocks.zh: SD涂装和复制纸无法改进每个域的基线检测。 即使结合25%的实际基线图像,这两项战略都会产生接近零或微不足道的收益(在所有情况下都是mAP@0.5 < 0.02)。 这种失败是始终如一的,在种子中可以复制。 对物体大小分布的分析(表四)显示,SD印版和复制版最小生成体积为图像宽度的8.2-11.4%,而真正的水下垃圾可小到1.3-5.8%。 这样可以防止产生这些领域常见的最小碎片物体,迫使探测器学习偏颇的大小扭曲合成分布。 此外,在作物粘贴的地方,复制纸有尖锐的视觉不连续,造成不切实际的边界文物。 更为根本的是,SD产生的垃圾缺乏现实的水下外观、纹理、腐蚀模式和海洋生长,而海洋生长是真正的废弃物的特点。 复制版的失败证实了对生成的限制,加上缺乏视觉现实主义,是成功的障碍. 相比之下,DALL-E可以产生全实际大小范围(至少3.5-7.7%)和现实的水下外观(表四)的物体,从而能够成功地进行探测转移。

blocks.en: DALL-E image-conditioned generation improves detection over the baseline in four of five domains. The one exception is B3, where DALL-E (0.33) falls short of baseline (0.45). B3 is characterized by larger objects and higher turbidity, where the baseline already achieves strong performance; additional gains are limited. However, DALL-E still provides a non-zero contribution when combined with baseline real data, whereas copy-paste and SD inpainting provide none. The key difference is object generation quality. DALL-E produces smaller, more realistically integrated trash objects that respect the size distribution of real underwater debris. Its whole-image FID is high (142–211) because it regenerates portions of the scene for contextual blending, but this global statistical drift is invisible to the downstream detector, which cares only about object-level realism. The realism difference is visible qualitatively in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: DALL-E图像条件生成改进了五个域中四个域基线的检测。 一个例外是B3,DALL-E(0.33)低于基线(0.45)。 B3的特点是物体较大,混浊度更高,基线已经实现强性能;额外收益有限. 然而,DALL-E在结合基准真实数据时仍提供非零贡献,而复制版和自毁涂料则不提供任何贡献。 关键区别在于对象生成质量. DALL-E生产更小,更现实的集成垃圾物体,尊重真实水下废弃物的大小分布. 其全图像FID是高的(142–211),因为它重新产生部分场景来进行背景混合,但这种全球统计漂移对于下游探测器来说是看不见的,它只关心物体级的现实主义. 图1显示现实主义差异的质量。

blocks.en: Overall, synthetic data alone is insufficient across all strategies in most domains. Synth-only training uniformly produces near-zero detection performance (mAP@0.5 < 0.05 except DALL-E on S1 where it reaches 0.43). The detector does not generalize from synthetic-only data to real test imagery without any real training examples. Mixing a small proportion of real data (25% of the baseline training set) stabilizes learning and enables the detector to ground synthetic patterns in real-world appearance. Even so, the dominant factor determining success is synthetic object realism, not the mix ratio: DALL-E + 25% baseline vastly outperforms copy-paste + 25% baseline or SD inpaint + 25% baseline in every domain. This underscores the finding that object-level realism, not the quantity of real data in the training mix, is the bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,在大多数领域的所有战略中,仅靠合成数据是不够的。 只有合成的训练统一产生接近零的探测性能(mAP@0.5 < 0.05, S1上的DALL-E除外,它达到0.43)。 探测器没有将仅从合成数据概括到真实测试图像,而没有任何真正的训练实例. 混合一小部分真实数据(基线训练集的25%)可以稳定学习,使探测器能够在现实世界外观中地面合成图案. 即便如此,决定成功与否的主导因素是合成对象现实主义,而不是混合比: DALL-E + 25% 基线大大超过复制-涂料+ 25% 基线或 SD Inpaint + 25% 基线在每个领域. 这突出表明了这样一个结论,即目标层面的现实主义,而不是训练组合中真实数据的数量,是瓶颈。

blocks.en: VII Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 七、结 论 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this study, we have proposed a fully automated, zero-annotation pipeline for generating labeled synthetic training data to address the annotation bottleneck in low-data underwater litter detection. By deriving YOLO labels directly from sampled bounding boxes, the pipeline eliminates manual annotation entirely, which is a critical advantage in data-scarce domains. Within a unified framework, we have systematically compared three object-insertion strategies: copy-paste, Stable Diffusion inpainting, and DALL-E image-conditioned generation, across five underwater domains of SeaClear data.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们提议建立一个完全自动化的零注解管道,以生成标注的合成培训数据,解决低数据水下垃圾探测中的注解瓶颈。 通过直接从取样的边框中提取YOLO标签,管道完全消除了手动注释,这是数据稀缺领域的一个关键优势。 在一个统一的框架内,我们系统地比较了三个插入物体的战略:复制版、稳定扩散涂层和DALL-E图像条件生成,跨越海清数据的五个水下领域。

blocks.en: Our key finding is that object-level realism, not distribution-level metrics, determines detection success. DALL-E image-conditioned generation achieves the only consistent detection improvements (4 of 5 domains, up to +96% relative mAP@0.5, example, for S2 domain from 0.14 to 0.27) despite scoring worst on FID and KID metrics, because it produces realistic trash objects. Copy-paste and SD inpainting fail uniformly across all domains, not due to label errors, but because they generate low quality trash images that are integrated into the real image and the object size exceeds real object size distributions. This reveals that conventional realism metrics are misleading in trash generation settings, and the appearance of the trash items is the deciding factor.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键发现是,对象级的现实主义,而不是分布级的度量衡,决定了检测成功. DALL-E图像条件生成实现唯一一致的检测改进(5个域中的4个域,最高为+96%的相对mAP@0.5,例如S2域从0.14到0.27),尽管FID和KID的度量标准评分最差,因为它会产生现实的垃圾对象. 复制版和SD印画在所有域都统一失败,不是因为标签错误,而是因为它们生成的低质量的垃圾图像被集成到真实图像中,对象大小超过真实对象大小分布. 这表明传统现实主义的衡量标准在垃圾生成环境中具有误导性,垃圾项目的外观是决定性因素.

blocks.en: A limitation of this study is that DALL-E is a closed, proprietary model whose architecture, training data, prompt-processing mechanisms, and generation procedures are not publicly disclosed. This limits the interpretability of why DALL-E outperforms the open-source strategies and may constrain reproducibility if the model, API, or prompt-processing behavior changes.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的一个局限性是,DALL-E是一种封闭的专有模式,其架构、培训数据、迅速处理机制和生成程序都不公开披露。 这限制了DALL-E为什么优于开源策略的解释性,并且可能限制如果模型,API,或即时处理行为发生变化的可复制性.

blocks.en: Directions for future work include: • The zero-annotation synthetic augmentation approach can be integrated into a complete semi-autonomous pipeline integrating synthetic bootstrapping with active learning and iterative retraining. • The zero-annotation pipeline can be evaluated on diverse tasks beyond litter detection.
blocks.zh: • 今后工作的方向包括: 零注解合成增强法可以融入一个完整的半自动管道,将合成靴子夹与主动学习和迭代再培训相结合。 除了检测垃圾之外,还可以对零通知管道的各种任务进行评估。

blocks.en: The zero-annotation synthetic augmentation approach can be integrated into a complete semi-autonomous pipeline integrating synthetic bootstrapping with active learning and iterative retraining.
blocks.zh: 零注解合成增强法可以融入一个完整的半自主管道,将合成靴夹与主动学习和迭代再培训相结合.
